activity: Waiting for the first verified hardware check and complete-run baseline.

baseline.full_cycle_definition: Wall time for the same complete postflop workload, including setup, solve, and required result evaluation. Solve time is reported separately.

accepted_complete_run.method: Pending comparable complete-run measurements and correctness validation.

validation.summary: No candidate has passed the required correctness and complete-run performance checks yet.

deployment.summary: Research results are separate from the application currently running.

schema_notes.timestamps: ISO 8601 with timezone; null until recorded. All timing values are milliseconds, or null when unmeasured. Write status.json atomically.
schema_notes.state: pending | running | paused | blocked | complete | failed
schema_notes.accepted_complete_run: The headline requires status=validated, scope=complete_run, correctness=pass, and positive baseline_ms and best_ms. These must be comparable measured full-cycle wall times. Never populate these from solve-only, kernel, setup-only, or summed worker times. method explains the workload, repeats, and aggregation. Speedup is calculated as (1 - best_ms / baseline_ms) * 100.
schema_notes.fixture_acceptance: best.status=accepted and correctness.status=pass are required before best timings or a fixture speedup are displayed. baseline and best fingerprints can be strings or objects containing multiple named fingerprints. A provisional baseline uses provisional:true, repetitions:1, status:single_measurement, and detail to describe its limits. Put candidate/rejected/invalid measurements in experiments.
schema_notes.experiment_status: queued | running | measured | accepted | rejected | invalid. Measured means timing was recorded, but acceptance is pending. Retain rejected and invalid experiments with their reason and evidence. A numeric experiment gain requires status=accepted and correctness=pass.

accepted_history_shape.method: Same comparison protocol as the headline.

evidence_shape.label: Benchmark log
evidence_shape.detail: Command, environment, timings, and correctness output.

schema_notes.evidence_urls: Relative HTTP-served paths or http(s) URLs. No local filesystem paths. Evidence arrays are supported at the root, per fixture, and per experiment.
schema_notes.deployment: status=deployed only after installation/activation has been verified. Use not_deployed, pending, or failed otherwise. Record candidate_id and commit separately from active research.
